title: Trimming on a cycle with a crew limit
heading: Vegetation Work Comes Back on a Cycle, So Deferring It Moves Work, Not Removes It
cases: with room for everything, each circuit is trimmed when due and again a cycle later
miles due but not trimmed are the year's backlog and come back the next year
the circuit longest since its last trim is trimmed first
a circuit too long for what is left does not stop shorter ones behind it
a circuit longer than any year's capacity is carried over and counts in the backlog every year
